evaluations.evidence: search and discover music
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained user search/discovery story; backlog contains upload and content metadata stories supporting discovery.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Profile-based discovery is supported by other user/profile search stories; no complementary capability is missing in the backlog for this feature.

evaluations.evidence: based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation-by-similarity is self-contained and does not expose any missing complementary create/read/update/delete capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video
evaluations.rationale: Content-similarity discovery is supported by upload/metadata stories; no required complementary capability is absent.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Uses metadata/tags which are covered by upload/tagging stories (e.g., ZO-006), so no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos
evaluations.rationale: Provides content creation (upload/tags) needed by many other stories; backlog contains this creation capability.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Viewing video thumbnails is a display feature and does not require an absent complementary capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Information-retrieval about similar items is supported by similarity/metadata stories; no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Perceptual-similarity information relies on existing similarity features; required complementary capabilities are present elsewhere in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation feature is supported by profile-based search and similarity stories; no missing complementary capability evident.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation-by-news is self-contained; backlog contains related content and metadata processing stories supporting it.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Person identification is a standalone detection/recognition capability; no complementary creation/update/delete requirement is missing.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Product-identification is a detection feature; backlog contains related info-retrieval stories and upload, no missing complement.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Logo identification is standalone; creation of logos is not required, so no missing complementary story.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification is detection-only; no absent complementary capability in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture
evaluations.rationale: Upload/take-picture creation exists and supports the recommendation feature; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Geolocation-based discovery is self-contained and backed by content ingestion and metadata stories (e.g., uploads); no missing complement.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is a retrieval capability; backlog includes content ingestion that makes this feasible—no missing complementary requirement.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Segmentation creation is addressed elsewhere (automatic segmentation stories such as ZO-036, ZO-032), so editing/validation is supported; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Admin annotation capability is explicit; it does not rely on any absent complementary creatorial capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Filtering/ranking is an analysis feature and does not require missing create/read/update/delete capabilities elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Assessment of uploaded audio is supported by ingestion/upload stories; no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Prefiltering is a detection capability applied to ingested content; upload stories provide required input—no missing complement.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low-level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Prefilter/search on asset info is supported by ingestion and metadata; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Validation applies to ingested content; ingestion/upload (ZO-006) supplies content so no missing complementary story.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags either recognized by the system of provided by the user
evaluations.rationale: High-level prefiltering relies on metadata/tags which are provided by upload/tagging stories; complementary capabilities present.

evaluations.evidence: citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: This story depends on volunteer 'citizen annotations' and Talk comments, but the backlog contains no stories enabling volunteers to create classifications/annotations or Talk comments, indicating a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Relies on volunteer annotations and Talk comments, but backlog lacks stories enabling volunteers to create annotations or comments (missing complementary capability).

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Identification of volunteer types is an analysis function that can operate on platform account/activity data; while volunteer activity generation stories are sparse, the backlog includes multiple admin/analytics features implying volunteer data ingestion—no explicit complementary capability missing solely for this story.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Automatic preclassification is a standalone processing feature; it does not depend on missing create/update/delete stories.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals
evaluations.rationale: Automatic detection of empty images is a processing feature and does not require absent complementary capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Image-series detection is an analysis capability; supported by ingestion and does not require missing complementary stories.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Automatic preclassification is self-contained and supported by existing ingestion/processing stories.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification is a processing feature; complementary capabilities for input exist in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Number-detection is analysis-only and does not expose a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Automatic segmentation is a content-processing feature; segmentation creation is provided so edit/validate stories are supported.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton
evaluations.rationale: Automatic detection of empty images is self-contained and requires no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Analysis capability supported by ingestion; no missing complementary story identified.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species
evaluations.rationale: Preclassification is an automated capability and does not require absent complementary functionality.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration
evaluations.rationale: Automated video processing is self-contained; backlog contains ingestion and processing features needed.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Detection of events in video is supported by ingestion and processing features; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Feature-detection on imagery is a processing capability; ingestion supports it, so no missing complementary story.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: This requires volunteer classifications to exist; the backlog contains no stories enabling volunteers to create classifications, exposing a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Artifact prefiltering is a processing step applicable to ingested images; necessary input capabilities exist in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Detection of motion/transients is an analysis feature relying on ingested imagery; no complementary capability missing.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Audio cleaning is a processing capability applied to uploaded audio; ingestion exists (ZO-006), so no missing complementary story.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Clustering/grouping of audio calls is an analysis feature and does not require absent complementary capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Detection/counting in audio files is a self-contained analysis function; ingestion provides data—no missing complementary story.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Requires monitoring volunteer activity and actions (volunteer tasks/interaction creation), but the backlog lacks stories enabling volunteers to perform tasks or generating activity data, so the complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Depends on detecting volunteer state and interactions; backlog lacks stories that enable volunteer interactions or generate the required activity data (missing complementary capability).

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Requires tracking volunteer actions/knowledge and providing education triggers; backlog has no stories enabling volunteer task activity or education state capture (missing complementary capability).

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Relies on volunteer interaction/context data to decide education modality; backlog lacks volunteer-action and comment creation stories, so complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Selecting educational content presumes volunteer performance/interaction data and educational content management; backlog lacks volunteer task/action creation stories to provide the necessary input (missing complementary capability).

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Depends on volunteers creating Talk comments; backlog contains no stories enabling volunteers to post comments or otherwise create that input, showing a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Determining Zoonibot triggers relies on volunteer comments/interactions as inputs; backlog lacks stories enabling volunteers to create those comments (missing complementary capability).

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Requires volunteer interaction data or comments as triggers; backlog lacks volunteer comment/classification creation stories needed as complementary capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Determining bot messages depends on volunteer interactions/annotations/comments; backlog contains no stories enabling volunteers to produce these inputs (missing complementary capability).

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Clustering/grouping is an analysis feature based on subject data; backlog has ingestion/processing stories, so no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Requires volunteer historical participation/experience data (i.e., volunteers creating classifications/comments across projects); the backlog lacks stories enabling volunteer task participation or recording of such experiences, so the complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Summarization and reuse of articles is a content-management feature; backlog contains content ingestion and metadata extraction stories that support this, so no missing complementary capability.
